documents.text: Qerveh, Zanjan Qerveh (, also Romanized as Qorveh; also known as Farvah, Ghorveh, Quenveh, and Qurveh) is a village in Howmeh Rural District, in the Central District of Abhar County, Zanjan Province, Iran. At the 2006 census, its population was 2,772, in 720 families. Qerveh is one of the oldest villages in Abhar County.
